body:
Final Rush: Prepare, Survive, Win
A fast-paced PvP mod that splits the game into two intense phases:

Preparation Phase: Players get a customizable amount of time (10 minutes by default) to mine, craft, and gear up. PvP is completely disabled during this time.

The Final Battle: When the timer hits zero, players are teleported to a safe distance from each other in the arena. PvP is enabled, and the hunt begins!


```
Easy Setup: Start a match instantly using the /finalrush start <player1> <player2> [minutes] command.
```
